title: Koler
description:
EMBARK EPIC ADVENTURE
Over 4+ stunning stylized worlds, each with its own unique style, procedural dungeon, handcrafted locales, fearsome foes and empowering bosses. Fight through the dungeon to empower yourself first and then defeat the final boss with your skills and strategy. Return to the center island, choose next world to go and vanquish them all. Finally challenge the Void Lord after you slayed all other bosses!

CRAFT NEW COLOR SHARDS
Obtain color cores from fallen bosses, and use them to craft new color shards.

SEEK OUT LEGENDARY RELICS OF POWER
Over 50+ relics add endless possibilities to each loop. Collect legendary relics, combine them with your own strategy or synthesize to a new one. Experiment with color shards and explore your own lore.

TAME & LEVEL UP YOUR BATTLE COMPANIONS
Tame new battle companions, adventure with them to gain experience and level their attributes up.

INFINITY POSSIBILITIES
With procedural generated dungeon, dynamic map, random loots and props, each loop offers unforgettable gaming experience.

JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER FOR MORE!
description_short: Embark on a solo or co-op adventure in this rogue-lite world of Koler, Slay infected creatures, build your arsenal with tons of Relics and Color Shards, tame and level up your battle companions, and finally fight through the dungeon and defeat the empowering bosses with endless possibilities!
